body.name: Complete legal \(K=4\) kill-test array
body.construction: Fix sufficiently large \(n\), put \(r_n=n^{-1/2}\), \(\delta_n=2\lambda_{\mathrm r}/\{n(1-r_n)\}\), \(Q_n^{(4)}(X=0)=1-r_n\), \(Q_n^{(4)}(X=1)=r_n\), and draw \(Z\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) conditionally independently of all potential variables. Every unit has \(D_{\mathrm{pot}}(0)=0\) and \(D_{\mathrm{pot}}(1)=1\). Conditional on \(X=0\), give survivor response types \((S_{\mathrm{pot}}(0),S_{\mathrm{pot}}(1),Y_{\mathrm{pot}}(0),Y_{\mathrm{pot}}(1))=(1,1,k,k)\) masses \(\ell^0=(\delta_n,.10,.10-\delta_n,.05)\); give selection-gain types \((S_{\mathrm{pot}}(0),S_{\mathrm{pot}}(1),Y_{\mathrm{pot}}(0),Y_{\mathrm{pot}}(1))=(0,1,0,k)\) masses \(h^0-\ell^0=(.10-\delta_n,0,\delta_n,.15)\), where \(h^0=(.10,.10,.10,.20)\); and give the never-selected type \((0,0,0,0)\) mass \(.50\). Conditional on \(X=1\), use survivor masses \(\gamma_{ij}=2\ell_i^1h_j^1\) with \(\ell^1=(.05,.15,.20,.10)\), \(h^1=(.10,.15,.15,.10)\), namely \(\gamma=\begin{pmatrix}.010&.015&.015&.010\\.030&.045&.045&.030\\.040&.060&.060&.040\\.020&.030&.030&.020\end{pmatrix}\), and put the remaining mass \(.50\) on \((S_{\mathrm{pot}}(0),S_{\mathrm{pot}}(1),Y_{\mathrm{pot}}(0),Y_{\mathrm{pot}}(1))=(0,0,0,0)\). Consistency determines the observables. The complete nonzero observed-atom table \(p_n^{(4)}(x,z;d,s,k)\), with \(k=0\) on \(s=0\), is \[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c}x&z&(d,s)&k&p_n^{(4)}\\\hline 0&0&(0,0)&0&.375(1-r_n)\\0&0&(0,1)&0&\lambda_{\mathrm r}/n\\0&0&(0,1)&1&.05(1-r_n)\\0&0&(0,1)&2&.05(1-r_n)-\lambda_{\mathrm r}/n\\0&0&(0,1)&3&.025(1-r_n)\\0&1&(1,0)&0&.25(1-r_n)\\0&1&(1,1)&0&.05(1-r_n)\\0&1&(1,1)&1&.05(1-r_n)\\0&1&(1,1)&2&.05(1-r_n)\\0&1&(1,1)&3&.10(1-r_n)\\1&0&(0,0)&0&.25r_n\\1&0&(0,1)&0&.025r_n\\1&0&(0,1)&1&.075r_n\\1&0&(0,1)&2&.10r_n\\1&0&(0,1)&3&.05r_n\\1&1&(1,0)&0&.25r_n\\1&1&(1,1)&0&.05r_n\\1&1&(1,1)&1&.075r_n\\1&1&(1,1)&2&.075r_n\\1&1&(1,1)&3&.05r_n\end{array}\] and every unlisted atom has mass zero.
